description: Flags a Subject once at least two related records have arrived within 30 days. WHY an aggregate fact and not a value comparison: this template's only Observation is an identifier string with no severity-like field of its own, so the closed fact catalogue's related-event-count aggregate (contracts/configuration.ts AggregateFactSchema, PLAN_AMENDMENTS A2) is the only fact that can express 'this is happening again' without inventing pack-specific logic in core.
